title: job-inventory declaration
description: The Jenkins jobs this repository claims to know about, and what each one is expected to be configured as. It is not written by hand: the first inventory run discovers the controller, and the declaration is derived from that snapshot. Nothing here is a credential.

folders.description: Folders to walk. An empty string walks the controller root.

maximumDepth.description: Levels to descend below each starting folder. A bound exists so a walk cannot run away on a controller whose folders discover their own children.

jobs.description: Declared jobs. A job found on the controller but absent here is reported as undeclared and never altered.

key.description: Stable short name used in reports.

path.description: Display path, folder segments separated by /.

enabled.description: false means the job is expected to be disabled.

scmUrl.description: Repository the job reads. Omit for a job with no SCM.

branchSpecifier.description: As stored in config.xml, verbatim: */main and refs/heads/main are different spellings and both are recorded as written.

scriptPath.description: Path of the Jenkinsfile within the repository.
